  "problem_id": "tmm_problem_cf712123ca1f601b",
  "original_request": "Design a planar two-layer antireflection coating on a semi-infinite glass substrate (constant refractive index 1.52, lossless), with air incidence (index 1.0). Use only lossless constant-index SiO2 (n=1.46) and TiO2 (n=2.40), one layer of each in either order. Each layer thickness must be between 40 and 160 nm. At normal incidence with s polarization, minimize the arithmetic mean power reflectance sampled from 450 to 700 nm at 5 nm spacing. A mean reflectance below 0.03 is the stated target. Use deterministic TMM only, with no RCWA, FDFD, learned surrogate or hardware. Allow at most two executed research rounds with one route and at most 64 solver evaluations per round, seed 17. After observing the actual result, choose a justified adjustment or stop. Do not claim the target was met without the spectrum and independent numeric check.",
  "normalized_request_english": "Design a planar two-layer antireflection coating on a semi-infinite glass substrate (refractive index 1.52, lossless) with air incidence (refractive index 1.0). The stack must consist of exactly one layer of SiO2 (n=1.46) and one layer of TiO2 (n=2.40) in either order. Each layer thickness is constrained between 40 nm and 160 nm. The objective is to minimize the arithmetic mean power reflectance for s-polarized light at normal incidence, sampled from 450 nm to 700 nm with 5 nm spacing, using deterministic Transfer Matrix Method calculations. A mean reflectance below 0.03 is a soft scoring preference. The optimization allows at most two research rounds with one route and up to 64 solver evaluations per round using seed 17. Results must be validated by spectrum and numeric check before claiming target achievement.",

  ],

  ],

  ],

    "high reflection in the 450-700 nm band"
  ],
  "known_stack_materials": [
    "incident medium: air (n=1.0)",
    "layer candidate 1: SiO2 (n=1.46, lossless)",
    "layer candidate 2: TiO2 (n=2.40, lossless)",
    "substrate: glass (n=1.52, lossless)"
  ],
  "design_variables": [
    "layer order (SiO2/TiO2 or TiO2/SiO2)",
    "thickness of the first layer (40-160 nm)",
    "thickness of the second layer (40-160 nm)"
  ],
  "manufacturing_constraints": [
    "layer thickness bounds: 40 nm to 160 nm",
    "exactly one layer of SiO2 and one layer of TiO2"
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "refractive indices are constant over the specified wavelength range",
    "interfaces are perfectly sharp and planar"
  ],
  "ambiguities": [],
  "method_research_questions": [
    "which layer ordering yields the global minimum reflectance within the thickness constraints",
    "whether the 0.03 mean reflectance target is achievable given the discrete material choices and thickness bounds"
  ],
  "needs_method_research": false
}
